newsapi.note: Get free API key from https://newsapi.org/ (100 requests/day free tier)

alphavantage.note: Get free API key from https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key (25 requests/day free tier)

gdelt.note: GDELT is completely free and requires no API key - provides global news coverage including Egyptian sources

smtp_config.note: For Gmail, use App Password (not regular password). Go to: https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords

sendgrid_config.note: Get free API key from https://sendgrid.com/ (100 emails/day free tier)

notes.provider: Use 'smtp' for Gmail/Outlook or 'sendgrid' for SendGrid service
notes.alert_recipients: List of email addresses to receive sentiment alerts
notes.digest_recipients: List of email addresses to receive daily digest emails
notes.positive_sentiment_threshold: Send alert when average sentiment >= this value (0 to 1)
notes.negative_sentiment_threshold: Send alert when average sentiment <= this value (-1 to 0)
notes.min_articles_for_alert: Minimum number of articles required to trigger alert

notes.sentiment_method: Use 'vader' (better for financial text) or 'textblob' for sentiment analysis
notes.cache_duration_hours: How long to cache news data before refreshing (in hours)
notes.relevance_threshold: Minimum relevance score (0.0-1.0) for articles to be included
